data.title: 姬岛朱乃 · 神社缘侧的罗裳半褪自抚
data.description: 夜幕降临的神社回廊外，清凉的夜风吹拂竹林。朱乃上身巫女白衣半敞露出丰满白皙的胸脯，红色绯袴系带解脱堆在腰间。她一手轻扶在木制栏杆上俯身弓腰，单手探入裙底拉开薄透内裤边缘轻揉水润敏感的花瓣。回廊灯笼映照下，朱乃眼角泛着羞耻泪光，回眸轻咬下唇娇喘连连——「啊啦……在神明面前……身体反而比平时更加敏感了呢……」
data.location: 神社僻静后院木质走廊缘侧栏杆旁
data.action: 一手扶木质走廊栏杆俯身翘臀，绯袴半解单手探入自抚花瓣，回头含羞潮红喘息
data.lighting: 庭院月光与廊下微弱纸灯笼光晕
data.promptProse: Along the wooden veranda outside the shrine hall at night, Akeno leans over the railing with one hand steadying herself against the timber. Cool silver moonlight blends with warm paper-lantern glow as she looks back over her shoulder.
data.nsfwProse: Her white miko robe falls open across her bare chest and her loosened scarlet hakama is gathered at her waist, allowing her free hand to reach underneath and shift her panties aside.
data.animaCaption: Bending forward with one hand gripping the wooden shrine veranda railing, she wears her white miko top open and scarlet hakama hiked up while her other hand slips past her shifted panties as she glances back with a flushed, lip-biting expression.
